name: Sumotori Dreams
description: Chat builds your Sumotori Dreams arena with points (!arena crate, !arena wall) and bets on who wins each round (!bet red 100), with a scoreboard overlay. No game mod needed: Stream Core writes an arena file that the game reloads by itself (in the game: Select Arena > Load Mod).

command_group.description: Sumotori Dreams arena pieces, bets and score (!arena, !bet, !score)

pages.title: Sumotori Dreams
pages.keywords: sumotori dreams sumo arena bets predictions scoreboard wrestling

overlays.name: Sumotori scoreboard
overlays.notes: Score, streak, open bets and the next arena's pieces. Transparent Browser source, about 420 x 300.

settings.label: Arena file
settings.help: Where Stream Core writes the arena. Empty = inside Core's data folder (the Sumotori Dreams page shows the full path). In the game: Select Arena > Load Mod > pick this file. A folder gets stream.smo inside it.

settings.label: Start from this arena (.smo)
settings.help: Optional. An arena file that works in your game; chat's pieces are added after its lines. Empty = a plain square floor with you (player 1) and three AI wrestlers.

settings.label: When bought pieces show up
settings.help: next_round = they wait for the next arena (Next arena button, or after a result). now = the file is rewritten straight away; if the game restarts the round when the file changes, use next_round.

settings.label: Pieces and prices (points)
settings.help: One per line, piece: points. 0 = not for sale. Pieces: crate, bigcrate, crates (a shower of five), wall, breakwall, pillars, step.

settings.label: Most pieces per chatter per arena
Give points back when you clear the queue
Pieces land this far from the middle
settings.help: Game units. Make it smaller if pieces land off the floor.

settings.label: Height of the floor's top
settings.help: Game units, negative is down. -7 fits the built-in floor; change it to match your own base arena.

settings.label: Last number of addbox for boxes that stay put
settings.help: Untested guess from the developer's example (1). If walls fall over or crates hang in the air, swap this and the next one.

settings.label: Last number of addbox for boxes that can move
Bets close after (s)
settings.help: 0 = they stay open until you press Close bets

settings.label: Biggest bet per chatter per round (points)
How winners are paid
settings.help: pool = winners share everyone's points by stake (like Twitch predictions; everyone gets their points back if one side had no bets). double = each winning bet pays twice its stake.

settings.label: Start the next arena when you set a result
settings.help: Pressing Red won / Blue won also loads the queued pieces (only with 'next_round').

settings.label: Open bets for the next round straight away
Say bets opening / closing, results and new arenas in chat
